onClientColShapeHit.description:
This event is triggered when a physical [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) hits a [colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/colshape).

* **Note:** The hit won't be detected if the [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) that entered the colshape is a colshape or projectile.

onClientColShapeLeave.description: This event is triggered when a physical [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) leaves a [colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/colshape).

onClientElementColShapeHit.description: This event is triggered when an element (like a player or vehicle) enters a collision shape.

onClientElementColShapeLeave.description: This event is triggered when an element (like a player or vehicle) leaves a collision shape.

onClientElementDataChange.description: This event is triggered ''after'' an element's [element data|data](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element data|data) entry is changed. Such changes can be made on the client or the server using [setElementData](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementData).

onClientElementDestroy.description: This event is triggered when an element gets destroyed by [destroyElement](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/destroyElement) or when the creator resource is stopping. It is also triggered when a children element of this element is destroyed. It is not triggered on a player when they quit.

onClientElementDimensionChange.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20724|This event is triggered when the dimension of an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is changed using [setElementDimension](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementDimension).}}

onClientElementInteriorChange.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20837|This event is triggered when the interior of an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is changed using [setElementInterior](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementInterior).}}

onClientElementModelChange.description: {{New feature/item|3.0157|1.5.6|16404|This event is triggered when the model of an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is changed using [setElementModel](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementModel).}}

onClientElementStreamIn.description:
This event is triggered whenever a physical element is streamed in. This is triggered for all elements that are streamable, such as players, peds, vehicles, objects and markers. When this event is triggered, that element is guaranteed to be physically created as a GTA object.

Be aware that this event triggers for local player (as itself being the element that got streamed in) when said local player spawns, as this is the creation of entity local ped.

__NOTOC__ * **Note:** This event also triggers for a remote player that dies in front of local player, even if they respawn far away.. the moment they do so, this event will be triggered, and if you'd measure distance between local and said remote player (that spawned far away) during this event, it would output the distance at which they died in front of local player, e.g 2 metres. This is bug-prone behavior and likely incorrect, to be fixed in the future, but for now be aware. The 'low distance' aspect of this (which could worsen your results) is caused by the split second that their ped elements may 'flash' past its wasted location during the respawning process. For now you can work around these side effect (both, or the distance aspect.. results may vary based on randomness) by adding an isPedDead check inside the event, checking source (said remote player), as this delays the onClientElementIn until after full respawn has taken place. The below script example incorporates this workaround

onClientElementStreamOut.description:
This event is triggered whenever a physical element is streamed out. This is triggered for all elements that are streamable, such as players, peds, vehicles, objects and markers when the local player is leaving the element. When this event is triggered, that element is no longer physical and is now virtualized by MTA.

__NOTOC__ * **Note:** Be aware that this event triggers for local player (as itself being the element that got streamed out) when said local player dies and respawns, as this is the removal & recreation of entity local ped.

onClientMarkerHit.description:
This event is triggered when a player enters a marker created using [createMarker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createMarker).

{{Important Note|The event is not triggered when only the dimension changes of the player. So, if you use the `matchingDimension` when teleporting players into existing markers you should always first set their dimension/interior and only then the position}}

onClientMarkerLeave.description: This event is triggered when a player leaves the area of a marker created using [createMarker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createMarker).

onClientPedDamage.description:
This event is triggered whenever a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) is damaged.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for peds that are streamed in

onClientPedHeliKilled.description:
This event is fired when a ped is killed due to the effect of a helicopter blades.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for peds that are streamed in

onClientPedHitByWaterCannon.description:
This event is fired when a ped is hit by a water cannon.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for peds that are streamed in

onClientPedVehicleEnter.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20740|This event is fired when a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) has entered a [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle).}}

onClientPedVehicleExit.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20740|This event is fired when a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) has exited a [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle).}}

onClientPedWasted.description: This event is triggered whenever a ped dies.

onClientPedWeaponFire.description:
This event is called when ped shoots a weapon.  This does not trigger for projectiles based, or melee weapons.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for peds that are streamed in

onClientPickupHit.description: This event triggers whenever a pickup is hit clientside.

onClientPickupLeave.description: This event triggers whenever a pickup is left clientside.

onClientPlayerChangeNick.description: This event is triggered when a player changes his nickname.

onClientPlayerChoke.description: This event is fired when the local player chokes due to the effect of a weapon such as tear gas grenades, fire extinguishers and spray cans.

onClientPlayerDamage.description:
This event is triggered whenever a player is damaged.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for players that are streamed in

onClientPlayerHeliKilled.description:
This event is fired when a player is killed due to the effect of a helicopter blades.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for players that are streamed in

onClientPlayerHitByWaterCannon.description:
This event is fired when a player is hit by a water cannon.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for players that are streamed in

onClientPlayerJoin.description:
This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) joins a server. It is triggered for all players except the local player, as the local player joins the server before their client-side resources are started. It would also be possible for two players to join within a few seconds of each other and for the two players' scripts may not receive onClientPlayerJoin events as their scripts wouldn't have started yet.

This event is not cancellable.

onClientPlayerPickupHit.description: This event triggers whenever a player hits a pickup locally.

onClientPlayerPickupLeave.description: This event triggers whenever a player leaves pickup locally.

onClientPlayerQuit.description: This event is triggered when a *remote* player quits the game or leaves the server. It *will not* get triggered on the source player's client. (Use [onClientResourceStop](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientResourceStop) to save client side data when the local player quits.)

onClientPlayerRadioSwitch.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player's radio station is changed

onClientPlayerSpawn.description: This event is triggered when any player, including a remote player, spawns.

onClientPlayerStealthKill.description: This event is triggered when the local player stealth kills another player.

onClientPlayerStuntFinish.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player finishes a vehicle stunt.

onClientPlayerStuntStart.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player starts doing a vehicle stunt.

onClientPlayerTarget.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player targets an element.

onClientPlayerVehicleEnter.description: This event is fired when a player has entered a vehicle.

onClientPlayerVehicleExit.description: This event is triggered when a player has exited a vehicle.

onClientPlayerVoicePause.description: This event is triggered when a player's voice sound is paused using [setSoundPaused](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setSoundPaused).

onClientPlayerVoiceResumed.description: This event is triggered when a player's voice sound is resumed using [setSoundPaused](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setSoundPaused).

onClientPlayerWasted.description: This event is triggered whenever a player, including those remote, dies.

onClientPlayerWeaponFire.description:
This event is called when a player fires a weapon.  This event does not trigger for melee weapons. Projectile weapons or the camera will only trigger the event if fired by the local player.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for players that are streamed in

* **Note:** This does not trigger for any player's melee weapons or for remote player's projectile weapons or cameras

onClientPlayerWeaponSwitch.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player's equipped *[weapon|weapon slot](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/weapon|weapon slot)* changes. This means giveWeapon and takeWeapon will trigger this event if the equipped slot is forced to change.

onClientObjectBreak.description:
This event is fired before an object breaks.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for objects that are streamed in

onClientObjectDamage.description:
This event is fired before an object gets damaged.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for objects that are streamed in.

onClientObjectMoveStart.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20811|This event is triggered when an [object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/object) starts moving.}}

onClientObjectMoveStop.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20811|This event is triggered when an [object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/object)'s movements stop.}}

onClientProjectileCreation.description: This event is triggered when a [projectile](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/projectile) is created.

onClientResourceFileDownload.description:
{{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20788|This event is triggered every time a [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource) file download is queued, finished or has failed.}}

{{Warning|This event is *NOT* related to [downloadFile](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/downloadFile) and [onClientFileDownloadComplete](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientFileDownloadComplete)!|true}}

onClientResourceStart.description:
This event is triggered when a [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource) is started.  Please note that this is *not* triggered the same time as the serverside event [onResourceStart](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onResourceStart) is.  The event is triggered when any ''clientside resources'' are started.  This means it is triggered when a clientside script is initiated after a download, which includes downloading after join. So:

* If a resource is running *before* a player joins, the onClientResourceStart event will be triggered after they join and have downloaded that resource.

* If a resource is started *after* a player has joined, the player will be made to download the required files, and then the onClientResourceStart event will be triggered.

onClientResourceStop.description: This event is triggered when a [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource) is being stopped.

onClientSoundChangedMeta.description: This event is triggered when a sound's meta tags have been modified.

onClientSoundFinishedDownload.description: This event is triggered when a sound has just finished downloading. This means the complete sound file is now loaded in the player's RAM, and can be played completely from start to end. Unlike [onClientSoundStream](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientSoundStream), this event only triggers for file streams, not for live ones since live streams never actually end.

onClientSoundStream.description: This event is triggered when a sound has just finished initial streaming. For file streams, this means the sound will now start playing, but isn't done downloading yet. For live streams, this just means the stream will start playing. This event will also trigger when, for some reason, the streaming failed.

onClientTrailerAttach.description: This event is triggered by a trailer when it gets attached to a towing vehicle.

onClientTrailerDetach.description: This event is triggered when a trailer gets detached from its towing vehicle.

onClientVehicleCollision.description:
This event is triggered when a vehicle collides with an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) or a world object.

Note that the collision reported by this event doesn't always damage the vehicle by default (this event triggers when hitting lamp posts, but the vehicle isn't damaged by them automatically, for example). If you want to deal with real damage, please refer to [onClientVehicleDamage](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientVehicleDamage).

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for vehicles that are streamed in

onClientVehicleEnter.description: This event gets fired when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) or [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) enters a vehicle.

onClientVehicleExit.description: This event gets fired when a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) or [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) gets out of a vehicle.

onClientVehicleExplode.description:
This event is triggered when a vehicle explodes.

* **Note:** This event can not be cancelled.

onClientVehicleNitroStateChange.description:
This event gets triggered when nitro state is changing.

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for vehicles that are streamed in

onClientVehicleRespawn.description: This event is triggered when a vehicle respawns.

onClientVehicleStartEnter.description: This event is triggered when a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) or [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) starts entering a vehicle. Once the entering animation completes, [onClientVehicleEnter](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientVehicleEnter) is triggered.

onClientVehicleStartExit.description: This event is triggered when a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) or [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) starts exiting a vehicle. Once the exiting animation completes, [onClientVehicleExit](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientVehicleExit) is triggered.

onClientWeaponFire.description:
This event triggers when a [Element/Weapon|custom weapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Weapon|custom weapon) fires a shot.

* **Note:** This event is *ONLY* for custom weapons that were created with [createWeapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createWeapon), for regular weapons use [onClientPlayerWeaponFire](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientPlayerWeaponFire).

* **Note:** This event is only triggered for custom weapons that are streamed in

onClientChatMessage.description: This event is triggered when any text is output to chatbox, including MTA's internal messages.

onClientConsole.description: This event is triggered when the local player enters text in the console. Note that, if you want to add custom console commands, it is easier to use the [addCommandHandler](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/addCommandHandler) function.

onClientCoreCommand.description:
{{New feature/item|3.0161|1.6.0|22649|

This event is triggered when a built-in client command is used, check [Client Commands](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Client Commands).}}

onClientDebugMessage.description:
This event is triggered when client-side debug messages (for instance errors or warnings) would appear in the debug window. This event doesn't require the debug window to be enabled to trigger, however.

*Note:* To prevent infinite loops, debug messages that occur inside the function that handles this event won't trigger this event, so you won't be able to rely on debug info to fix faulty code that is inside this function. Since build [https://buildinfo.mtasa.com/index.php?Revision=14683 r14683] debug messages from [outputDebugString](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/outputDebugString) and [iprint](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/iprint) will show up.

onClientExplosion.description: This event is triggered every time an explosion is created on the current *clients scene* (inside the streamer).

onClientHUDRender.description: This event is triggered before GTA renders the HUD. This is particularly useful if you want to use [dxUpdateScreenSource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/dxUpdateScreenSource) to capture the screen onto a texture without capturing the HUD, or to alter HUD textures using [Element/Shader|shaders](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Shader|shaders) before they are drawn onto the screen.

onClientMinimize.description:
This event is triggered when the local player minimizes the game screen.

{{Note | This event only triggers from fullscreen minimize. [onClientRestore](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientRestore) can trigger even if this event didn't.}}

onClientMTAFocusChange.description: {{New feature/item|3.0160|1.5.9|21313| This event is triggered every time the MTA window gains or loses focus.}}

onClientPedsProcessed.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20704|This event is triggered after GTA updates bone transformations for all peds. This event can be used for updating bones.}}

onClientPreRender.description: This event is triggered every time before GTA renders a new frame.

onClientRender.description: This event is triggered every time GTA renders a new frame. It is required for the DirectX drawing functions, and also useful for other clientside operations that have to be applied repeatedly with very short time differences between them.

onClientRestore.description: This event is triggered when the local player restores the game screen from a previously minimized state.

onClientTransferBoxProgressChange.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20788|This event is triggered every time the [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource) file downloader (aka. transfer box) updates the download progress.}}

onClientTransferBoxVisibilityChange.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20788|This event is triggered every time the [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource) file downloader (aka. transfer box) is shown or hidden by MTA.}}

onAccountDataChange.description: This event is triggered when an accounts data changes through [setAccountData](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setAccountData).

onAccountCreate.description: {{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22470|This event is triggered every time an [account](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/account) is created}}

onAccountRemove.description: {{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22470|This event is triggered every time an [account](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/account) is removed}}

onConsole.description:
This event is triggered when a player types a message into his console. It is also triggered when entering '/' commands via the chatbox.

* **Note:** The event will not be triggered if the message can be processed by an existing command handler

onColShapeHit.description:
* **Note:** The hit won't be detected if the [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) that entered the colshape is a colshape.

This event is triggered when a physical [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) hits a [colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/colshape).

onColShapeLeave.description: This event is triggered when a player or a vehicle leaves a collision shape.

onElementClicked.description: This event is triggered when an element is clicked on by the client. These events can only trigger when the client has its cursor enabled. It triggers for all three mousebuttons in both their up and down states.

onElementColShapeHit.description: This event is triggered when an player or vehicle element collides with a colshape.

onElementColShapeLeave.description: This event is triggered when an player or vehicle element leaves the area of a [colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/colshape).

onElementDataChange.description: This event is triggered ''after'' an element's [element data|data](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element data|data) entry is changed. Such changes can be made on the client or the server using [setElementData](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementData).

onElementDestroy.description: This event is triggered when an element gets destroyed by [destroyElement](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/destroyElement) or when the creator resource is stopping. It is also triggered when a parent element of this element is destroyed.

onElementDimensionChange.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20724|This event is triggered when the dimension of an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is changed using [setElementDimension](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementDimension).}}

onElementInteriorChange.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20837|This event is triggered when the interior of an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is changed using [setElementInterior](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementInterior).}}

onElementModelChange.description: This event is triggered when the model of an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is changed using [setElementModel](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementModel).

onElementStartSync.description: This event is triggered when an element becomes synced by a player.

onElementStopSync.description: This event is triggered when an element is no longer synced by a player.

onMarkerHit.description:
This event is triggered when an element enters a marker created using [createMarker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createMarker).

{{Important Note|The event is not triggered when only the dimension changes of the player. So, if you use the `matchingDimension` when teleporting players into existing markers you should always first set their dimension/interior and only then the position}}

onMarkerLeave.description: This event is triggered when an element leaves the area of a marker created using [createMarker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createMarker).

onPickupHit.description: This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) hits a [pickup](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/pickup).

onPickupSpawn.description: This event is triggered when a [pickup](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/pickup) is spawned or respawned.

onPickupUse.description:
This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) stands on a [pickup](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/pickup) while not in a [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle).

{{Tip|Pickups use [colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/colshape)s, you can get the [colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/colshape) of the [pickup](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/pickup) with [getElementColShape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/getElementColShape) and use [colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/colshape) [event](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/event)s to it.}}

onPlayerBan.description: This event is triggered when a player added a [ban](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ban) (like [onBan](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onBan)).

onPlayerChangeNick.description: This event is triggered when a player changes his nickname.

onPlayerChangesWorldSpecialProperty.description: {{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22815|This event is triggered every time a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) calls [setWorldSpecialPropertyEnabled](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setWorldSpecialPropertyEnabled).}}

onPlayerChangesProtectedData.description: {{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22790|This event is triggered when a player tries to change protected element data. The server protects element data with using [Server_mtaserver.conf#elementdata_whitelisted|elementdata_whitelisted](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Server_mtaserver.conf#elementdata_whitelisted|elementdata_whitelisted) from *mtaserver.conf* and the *clientChangesPolicy* parameter in [setElementData](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementData).}}

onPlayerChat.description: This event is triggered when a player chats inside the chatbox.

onPlayerClick.description: This event is triggered when a player clicks using the mouse cursor.

onPlayerCommand.description:
This event is triggered when a player issues a command.

* **Note:** This event triggers regardless of whether the command exists in a script or is hardcoded. Also, typing anything in chat will execute the internal command "say", so this event will be triggered on every chat message as well. Therefore you should avoid excessive use of this function on busy servers, out of performance considerations.

onPlayerConnect.description:
This event is triggered when a player attempts to connect to the server.

{{MessageBox|

bordercolorhex = CC3333 |

bgcolorhex = FF8888 |

message = *WARNING:*

* You should never, under any circumstances, modify the player returned by [getPlayerFromName](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/getPlayerFromName) before [onPlayerJoin](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onPlayerJoin) to avoid desynchronization (e.g. [setPlayerName](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setPlayerName)).

* If you want to set custom disconnect text, [cancelEvent](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/cancelEvent) *should be called at the end* of the onPlayerConnect event, otherwise the client will be displayed the default text if any other event, native or custom, is triggered before cancelling.

}}

onPlayerContact.description: This event is triggered when a player stands on a different element than before.

onPlayerDamage.description:
This event is triggered when a player is damaged, in any way.

*This event is not triggered when attacked by a team member if friendly fire is enabled.

*Canceling this event has no effect. Cancel the client-side event [onClientPlayerDamage](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientPlayerDamage) instead.

*onPlayerDamage doesn't trigger if the damage kills the player, [onPlayerWasted](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onPlayerWasted) is called instead.

onPlayerDetonateSatchels.description: {{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22293|This event is triggered every time satchels are detonated - either by a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) or through [detonateSatchels](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/detonateSatchels).}}

onPlayerJoin.description: This event is triggered when a player joins the server. This event is not cancellable.

onPlayerLogin.description: This event is triggered when a player logs into their account in-game.

onPlayerLogout.description: This event is triggered when a user logs out of their account in-game.

onPlayerMarkerHit.description:
This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) hits a [marker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/marker).

* **Note:** This event is triggered for <b>players</b> only. Attaching this event to a marker does nothing.

onPlayerMarkerLeave.description: This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) leaves the area of a [marker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/marker).

onPlayerModInfo.description:
This event is triggered when a player has modified certain files.

* **Note:** Any resource using this event should call [resendPlayerModInfo](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resendPlayerModInfo) for each player in [onResourceStart](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onResourceStart).

onPlayerMute.description: This event is triggered when a player has been muted by [setPlayerMuted](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setPlayerMuted).

onPlayerPickupHit.description: This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) hits a [pickup](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/pickup).

onPlayerPickupUse.description: This event is triggered when a player is standing on a pickup while not being in a vehicle.

onPlayerPrivateMessage.description: This event is triggered when a player sends a private message with ''msg'' command.

onPlayerProjectileCreation.description: {{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22293|This event is triggered every time a projectile is created by a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) - either through a weapon, a vehicle weapon or [createProjectile](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createProjectile).}}

onPlayerQuit.description: This event is triggered when a player disconnects from the server.

onPlayerScreenShot.description: This event is triggered when the screen capture requested by [takePlayerScreenShot](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/takePlayerScreenShot) has completed.

onPlayerSpawn.description: This event is called when a player spawns.

onPlayerStealthKill.description: This event is triggered when a player stealth kills another player.

onPlayerTarget.description: This event is triggered when a player targets an element with his crosshair while aiming, or simply facing it while standing close. It's triggered again when the player no longer targets anything.

onPlayerTeamChange.description:
{{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22447|This event is triggered whenever a player's team changes.}}

Additionally, this event is triggered for all players on a team when that team is destroyed.

onPlayerTriggerEventThreshold.description:
{{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22313|This event is triggered when a player exceeds the maximum threshold for events via [triggerServerEvent](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/triggerServerEvent).}}

During each interval (''player_triggered_event_interval''), all usage of [triggerServerEvent](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/triggerServerEvent) will be counted for each player. This includes registered events, non-registered events and non-remote events.

If the count exceeds ''max_player_triggered_events_per_interval'', this event will be fired. The count is reset each interval.

You can set these options via [setServerConfigSetting](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setServerConfigSetting).

onPlayerTriggerInvalidEvent.description:
{{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|22459|This event is triggered whenever a player trigger invalid event on server-side.}}

It works for both non-added and non-remote events.

onPlayerUnmute.description: This event is triggered when a player has been unmuted by [setPlayerMuted](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setPlayerMuted).

onPlayerVehicleEnter.description: This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) enters a vehicle.

onPlayerVehicleExit.description: This event is triggered when a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) leaves a vehicle, for whatever reason.

onPlayerVoiceStart.description:
<div style="border: 1px dotted blue; background: #00CC66;padding:4px;margin-bottom:2px;">*Note*:  This event should only be used as a low-level function for advanced users.  For typical Voice scripting, please see the [Resource:Voice|Voice Resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Resource:Voice|Voice Resource)</div>

This event is triggered when a player starts talking through voice chat.

onPlayerVoiceStop.description:
This event is triggered when a player stops talking through voice chat.

{{Important Note|This event should only be used as a low-level function for advanced users.  For typical Voice scripting, please see the [Resource:Voice|Voice Resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Resource:Voice|Voice Resource)}}

onPlayerWasted.description: This event is triggered when a player is killed or dies.

onPlayerWeaponSwitch.description: This event is triggered whenever a player's equipped weapon *slot* changes. This means [giveWeapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/giveWeapon) and [takeWeapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/takeWeapon) will trigger this event if the equipped slot is forced to change.

onPedDamage.description:
This event is triggered when a ped is damaged. For player damage, use [onPlayerDamage](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onPlayerDamage) instead.

* **Note:** This event is not triggered prior to r21247.

onPedVehicleEnter.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20740|This event is triggered when a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) enters a [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle).}}

onPedVehicleExit.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20740|This event is triggered when a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) leaves a [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle).}}

onPedWasted.description: This event is triggered when a ped is killed or dies. It is not triggered for players.

onPedWeaponSwitch.description: This event is triggered when a ped switches weapons.

onPlayerResourceStart.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20957|This event is triggered when a [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource) has loaded client-side for a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player).}}

onResourceLoadStateChange.description: {{Added feature/item|1.5.9|1.5.8|20809|This event is triggered when a [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource) load state is changed.}}

onResourcePreStart.description:
Analogous to [onResourceStart](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onResourceStart), but triggered before script files are initialised.

* **Note:** This event isn't triggered within the resource starting.

onResourceStart.description:
This event is triggered when a resource is started.

*Important:* If you attach this event to the root element it will called when ''any'' resource starts, not just the resource your script is running inside. As such, most of the time you will want to check that the resource passed to this event matches your resource (compare with the value returned by [getThisResource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/getThisResource) before doing anything. Alternatively you can attach the event to resourceRoot.

onResourceStop.description:
This event is triggered when the resource is stopped. This can occur for a number of reasons:

* The ''stop'' console command was used

* The ''restart'' console command was used

* The resource was modified (the resource will automatically restart)

* Another resource stopped it using [stopResource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/stopResource).

*Note:* If you wish to just detect a single resource being stopped, you should attach handlers for this event to the resource's root element. You can access this using [getResourceRootElement](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/getResourceRootElement).

onBan.description: This event is triggered when an IP address or serial is banned from the server.

onDebugMessage.description:
This event is triggered when debug messages (for instance errors or warnings) appear in the server console.

*Note:* To prevent infinite loops, debug messages that occur inside the function that handles this event won't trigger this event, so you won't be able to rely on debug info to fix faulty code that is inside this function. Since build [https://buildinfo.mtasa.com/index.php?Revision=14683 r14683] debug messages from [outputDebugString](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/outputDebugString) and [iprint](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/iprint) will show up.

onExplosion.description: {{Added feature/item|1.6.1|1.6.0|21914|This event is triggered every time an explosion is created either by server-side [createExplosion](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createExplosion), or when reported by [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player).}}

onSettingChange.description: This event is triggered when resource setting has been changed. For instance, this event would trigger if you would edit the settings of the Race resource through the Admin panel.

onUnban.description:
This event is triggered when a ban is removed from the server.

if the ban was removed using function [removeBan](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/removeBan), and the responsibleElement was not specifying, the event will return nil.

onShutdown.description:
{{New feature/item|3.161|1.6.0|22837|This event is triggered when the server is about to be stopped using the server console or the [shutdown](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/shutdown) function.}}

* **Note:** There is no 100% guarantee that all the code and operations executed in this event will finish before the server is stopped. Therefore, avoid complex actions like triggers or exports, as there may not be enough time to complete the operations and execute the full code

onTrailerAttach.description:
{{Needs Checking|Cancellation of event has no effect. detachTrailerFromVehicle in the event doesn't work either, 50 ms timer is effective.}}

This event is triggered when a trailer is attached to a truck or when a tow truck hooks on to a vehicle.

onTrailerDetach.description: This event is triggered when a trailer is detached from a truck.

onVehicleDamage.description: This event is triggered when a vehicle is damaged. If you want to get the attacker you can use [onClientVehicleDamage](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onClientVehicleDamage).

onVehicleEnter.description: This event is triggered when a player or ped enters a vehicle.

onVehicleExit.description: This event is triggered when a player or ped leaves a vehicle.

onVehicleExplode.description:
This event is triggered when a vehicle explodes.

* **Note:** This event can not be canceled.

onVehicleRespawn.description: This event is triggered when a vehicle is respawned due. See [toggleVehicleRespawn](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/toggleVehicleRespawn).

onVehicleStartEnter.description: This event is triggered when a player or ped starts to enter a vehicle. This event can be used to cancel entry, if necessary.

onVehicleStartExit.description: This event is triggered when a player or ped starts to exit a vehicle. This event can be used to cancel exit, if necessary.

attachElements.description:
This function attaches one element to another, so that the first one follows the second whenever it moves.

If an attempt is made to attach two elements that are already attached the opposite way (eg theElement becomes theAttachToElement and vice versa), the 1st attachment order is automatically detached in favor of the 2nd attachment order. For example, if carA was attached to carB, now carB is attached to carA. Also, an element cannot be attached to two separate elements at one time. For example, two cars can be attached to one single car, but one single car cannot be attached to two separate cars. If you attempt to do this, the existing attachment will automatically be dropped in favor of the new attachment. For example, if carA is asked to attached to carB then carC, it is only attached to carC.

This is not compatible with all elements.  The following elements are compatible:

* [Ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Ped)s

* [Player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Player)s

* [Blip](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Blip)s

* [Vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Vehicle)s

* [Object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Object)s

* [Marker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Marker)s

* [Pickup](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Pickup)s

* [Sound](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Sound)s

* [Colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Colshape)s

* [createWeapon|Weapons](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createWeapon|Weapons)

* [Camera](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Camera)s

{{Note|

*The offset coodinates reflect the object space, not the world space. This means that you cannot calculate the exact offsets between two objects by pre-positioning them in the map editor as a reference. Please see [attachElementsOffsets](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/attachElementsOffsets) for more details.

*Due to a limitation in GTA, unexpected attach rotations may occur if all rotation offsets are non-zero. (i.e. Try to ensure at least one of 'xRotOffset', 'yRotOffset' or 'zRotOffset' is zero).}}

createElement.description:
This function is used to create a new dummy element in the [element tree](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element tree) which do not necessarily represent an entity within the San Andreas world. A common use for this function is for creating custom elements, such as a Flag or a Base.

Elements created using this function are placed in the element tree with their parent as the 'dynamic' map element.

destroyElement.description:
This function destroys an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) and all elements within it in the hierarchy (its children, the children of those children etc). [player|Player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player|Player) elements cannot be destroyed using this function. A player can only be removed from the hierarchy when they quit or are kicked. The root element also cannot be destroyed, however, passing the root as an argument will wipe all elements from the server, except for the players and clients, which will become direct descendants of the root node, and other elements that cannot be destroyed, such as resource root elements.

* **Note:** There is bug when you try to destroy webbrowser that returned from guiGetBrowser so instead of that destroy the gui-element one that returned from guiCreateBrowser otherwise the game will be crushed (By Master_MTA).

Players are not the only elements that cannot be deleted. This list also includes remote clients and console elements.

* **Note:** As element ids are eventually recycled, always make sure you nil variables containing the element after calling this function

detachElements.description: This function detaches attached elements from one another.

getAttachedElements.description: This function returns a table of all the elements attached to the specified element

getElementAlpha.description: This function returns the alpha (transparency) value for the specified [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element). This can be a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player), [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped), [object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/object), [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle) or [Element/Weapon|weapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Weapon|weapon).

getElementAttachedOffsets.description: This function returns the offsets of an element that has been attached to another element using [attachElements](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/attachElements).

getElementAttachedTo.description: This function determines the element that the specified element is attached to.

getElementByIndex.description:
__NOTOC__ {{Important Note|If you wish to retrieve more than one element at a time, it is more efficient to use [getElementsByType](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/getElementsByType) instead.}}

This function returns an element of the specified type with the specified index.

getElementByID.description:
This function returns an element from the specified ID. If more than one element with the same ID exists, only the first one in the order it appears in the XML tree will be returned by this function.

* **Note:** The ID in this context is the value of the 'id' data item of the element (the <nowiki>id=".."</nowiki> attribute in the .map file), NOT the model ID, weapon ID or similiar.

getElementChild.description: This function returns one of the child elements of a given parent element. The child element is selected by its index (0 for the first child, 1 for the second and so on).

getElementChildren.description: This function is used to retrieve a list of the child elements of a given parent element. Note that it will only return direct children and not elements that are further down the [element tree](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element tree).

getElementChildrenCount.description: This function returns the number of children an element has. Note that only the direct children are counted and not elements that are further down the [element tree](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element tree).

getElementCollisionsEnabled.description: This function indicates if a specific element is set to have collisions disabled. An element without collisions does not interact with the physical environment and remains static.

getElementColShape.description: Some elements have an associated colshape, for example [Marker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Marker) and [Pickup](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Pickup). This function is used to get the associated colshape.

getElementData.description: This function retrieves [element data](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element data) attached to an element under a certain key.

getAllElementData.description:
{{New feature/item|3.0161|1.6.0|21695|Added also as a client-side function. Previously only available as a server-side function.}}

Returns a table of all element data of an element.

hasElementData.description:
{{New feature/item|3.0158|1.5.7|20447|

This function checks if an element has [element data](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element data) available under a certain key.}}

getElementDimension.description: This function allows you to retrieve the dimension of an element. See [Dimension](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Dimension) for the list of valid element types. The dimension determines what/who the element is visible to.

getElementHealth.description: This function returns the current health for the specified [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element). This can be a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player), a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped), a [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle), or an [object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/object).

getElementID.description:
This function gets the ID of an element. This is the "id" attribute of the element and is a string, NOT a number like a model ID, weapons ID or similar.

* **Note:**  This function can also be used to get the resource name of any ''resource-data''.

getElementInterior.description: This function allows you to retrieve the interior of any element. An interior is the current loaded place, 0 being outside.

getElementModel.description: Returns the model ID of a given element. This can be a player/ped skin, a pickup model, an object model or a vehicle model.

getElementParent.description: This function is used to determine the parent of an ''element''.

getElementPosition.description:
The getElementPosition function allows you to retrieve the position coordinates of an element.  This can be any real world element, including:

* [Element/Player|Players](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Player|Players)

* [Element/Vehicle|Vehicles](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Vehicle|Vehicles)

* [Element/Object|Objects](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Object|Objects)

* [Element/Pickup|Pickups](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Pickup|Pickups)

* [Element/Marker|Markers](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Marker|Markers)

* [Element/Collision shape|Collision shapes](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Collision shape|Collision shapes)

* [Element/Blip|Blips](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Blip|Blips)

* [Element/Radar area|Radar areas](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Radar area|Radar areas)

getElementsByType.description:
{{Server_client_function}}

This function is used to retrieve a list of all elements of the specified type. This can be useful, as it disregards ''where'' in the element tree it is. It can be used with either the built in types (listed below) or with any custom type used in a .map file. For example, if there is an element of type "flag" (e.g. <flag />) in the .map file, the using "flag" as the type argument would find it.

getElementType.description: This function is used to retrieve the type of an element.

getElementVelocity.description: This function returns three floats containing the velocity (movement speeds) along the X, Y, and Z axis respectively. This means that velocity values can be positive and negative for each axis.

getLowLODElement.description: This function return the low LOD element that an element is associated with.

getRootElement.description:
This function returns the root node of the [element tree](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element tree), called ''root''. This node contains every other element: all resource root elements, players and remote clients. It is never destroyed and cannot be destroyed using [destroyElement](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/destroyElement).

It is often used to attach handler functions to events triggered for any element, or also to make a scripting function affect all elements.

* **Note:** All resources have a [Predefined_variables_list|predefined global variable](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Predefined_variables_list|predefined global variable) called ''root'' that has the root element as value. The variable exists server side as well as client side.

isElement.description:
This function checks if a value is an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) or not.

* **Note:** This function is not reliable as element ids are eventually recycled. Always make sure you nil variables containing an element after calling [destroyElement](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/destroyElement) or handle [onElementDestroy](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/onElementDestroy) for players and elements that might be destroyed by another resource

isElementAttached.description:
<!-- Describe in plain english what this function does. Don't go into details, just give an overview -->

This functions checks whether or not an element is attached to another element.

isElementCallPropagationEnabled.description:
{{Server_client function}}

This functions checks if certain element has call propagation enabled.

isElementDoubleSided.description: This function checks whether an element is double-sided as set by [setElementDoubleSided](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementDoubleSided) or not.

isElementFrozen.description: This function checks if element has been frozen.

isElementInWater.description: This function checks whether an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is submerged in water.

isElementLowLOD.description:
This function reveals if an element is low LOD.

* **Note:** See [setLowLODElement](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setLowLODElement) for the list of valid element types that can be assigned with that function.

isElementOnFire.description: {{New feature/item|3.0161|1.6.0|22864|This function checks if the specified [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is on fire or not.}}

isElementWithinColShape.description:
This function is used to determine if an element is within a collision shape. Please note that for legacy reasons, a colshape created on the client does not collide with elements already existing at that location until they first move. Please also note that before 1.0.3, this did not function correctly when moving a colshape.

Please note that this function doesn't verify whether element is in the same dimension and interior, additional checks could be implemented manually if they are needed.

isElementWithinMarker.description: This function is used to determine if an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) is within a [marker](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/marker).

setElementAlpha.description:
[file:SetElementAlpha.png|400px|thumb|right|Player ped alpha demonstration. Shown alpha levels are 255, 100 and 0 (left to right).](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/file:SetElementAlpha.png|400px|thumb|right|Player ped alpha demonstration. Shown alpha levels are 255, 100 and 0 (left to right).)

This function sets the alpha (transparency) value for the specified [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element). This can be a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player), [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped), [object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/object), [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle) or [Element/Weapon|weapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Weapon|weapon).

setElementAngularVelocity.description: {{New feature/item|3.0156|1.5.5|14165|Sets the angular velocity of a specified, supported element (Applies a spin to it).}}

getElementAngularVelocity.description: {{New feature/item|3.0156|1.5.5|14165|Gets the current angular velocity of a specified, supported element.}}

setElementAttachedOffsets.description: This function updates the offsets of an element that has been attached to another element using [attachElements](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/attachElements).

setElementCallPropagationEnabled.description:
{{Server_client function}}

This function enables/disables call propagation on a certain element. Look at the example for a practical application.

setElementCollisionsEnabled.description:
This function can disable or enable an element's collisions. An element without collisions does not interact with the physical environment and remains static.

* **Note:** Vehicles that are collisionless and have a driver will cause bugs.

* **Note:** Enabling a players collisions when they're inside a vehicle will cause bugs.

* **Note:** Disabling a peds collisions will cause some problems, such as it being unable to move or wrong rotation after creation.

setElementDimension.description: This function allows you to set the [dimension](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/dimension) of an element. See [Dimension](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Dimension) for the in-depth explanation and the list of valid element types.

setElementDoubleSided.description:
This function allows you to set the double-sidedness of an element's model. When an element's model is double-sided, it's back facing triangles become visible.

Possible uses of double-sidedness are: Elimination of invisible walls, using buildings as enclosures, using inverted landmasses as large pits or to make cave networks. It can also remove the need to add extra triangles to custom models when trying to make them appear solid from all directions.

setElementFrozen.description:
This function freezes an element (stops it in its position and disables movement) or unfreezes it.

{{Warning|This function cancels any animation set by setPedAnimation if you freeze the ped.}}

setElementHealth.description:
This function sets the health for the specified [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element). This can be a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped), [object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/object) or a [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle).

{{Note|In the case of the [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle) element, the following effects appear, depending on the health value:

**650:* white steam 0%, black smoke 0%

**450:* white steam 100%, black smoke 50%

**250:* white steam 0%, black smoke 100%

**249:* fire with big black smoke

}}

setElementID.description:
This function sets the ID of an element to a string. This can be anything from an identifying number, to a name.

You can only change the ID of an element clientside if that element has been created clientside as well.

setElementInterior.description:
This function allows you to set the [interior](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/interior) of any element. An interior is the current loaded place, 0 being outside.

* **Note:** If passing the same interior as the element is in, the call will be ignored and position (optional arguments) will not be set either. Use [setElementPosition](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementPosition) separately to be sure the position will be set.

* **Note:** Some [Object|objects](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Object|objects)/[Building|buildings](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Building|buildings) in *interior 13* show in all interiors.

setElementModel.description: Sets the model of a given element. This allows you to change the model of a player (or ped), a vehicle or an object.

setElementPosition.description:
This function sets the position of an element to the specified coordinates.

{{Warning|Do not use this function to spawn a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player). It will cause problems with other functions like [warpPedIntoVehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/warpPedIntoVehicle). Use [spawnPlayer](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/spawnPlayer) instead.}}

setElementRotation.description:
Sets the rotation of elements according to the world (does not work with players that are on the ground).

{{Tip|New scripts should set *conformPedRotation* to ''true'' when using this function on [Ped|peds](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Ped|peds). This will prevent quirky old behaviour.}}

* **Note:** This function does not work on [Element/Collision_shape|colshape](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Collision_shape|colshape).

* **Note:** This function does not work on [createElement|dummy element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createElement|dummy element).

setElementVelocity.description:
This function sets the velocity (movement speeds) along each axis, for an element.

This is not compatible with all elements. Only the following element types are compatible:

* [Ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Ped)

* [Vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Vehicle)

* [Object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Object)

* [Projectile](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Projectile)

{{Deprecated feature|3.0140|1.4|

Objects and projectiles velocity can only be set clientside.}}

setLowLODElement.description:
This function assigns a low LOD element to an element. The low LOD element is displayed when its associated element is not fully visible. If a low LOD element is assigned to several elements, it will be displayed when any of these elements are not fully visible.

* **Note:** The only valid elements types for assigning LODs with this function are [Object](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Object) and [Building](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Building).

getPedContactElement.description: This function detects the element a ped is standing on. This can be a vehicle or an object.

getResourceDynamicElementRoot.description: This function retrieves the ''dynamic element root'' of a specified [resource](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/resource). The ''dynamic element root'' is the parent of elements that are created by scripts (e.g. with [createObject](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/createObject)) unless they specify a different parent.

getResourceRootElement.description:
This function retrieves a resource's root element. The resource's root element is the element in the element tree which is the parent of all elements that belong to a particular resource (except for elements specifically created elsewhere). You can attach event handlers to this element to easily capture events that originate from your resource (and global events that originate from the root element).

Note: every resource has a [Predefined_variables_list|predefined global variable](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Predefined_variables_list|predefined global variable) called ''resourceRoot'' whose value is the root element of that resource.

addPedClothes.description:
* **Note:** This function only works with peds using CJ skin (ID 0).

This function is used to set the current clothes on a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped).

getPedClothes.description: This function is used to get the current clothes texture and model of a certain type on a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped).

removePedClothes.description: This function is used to remove the current clothes of a certain type on a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped). It will remove them if the clothesTexture and clothesModel aren't specified, or if they match the current clothes on that slot.

createPed.description: Creates a Ped in the GTA world.

getPedAmmoInClip.description: This function returns an integer that contains the ammo in a specified [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped)'s weapon. See [weapon|Weapon Info](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/weapon|Weapon Info)

getPedArmor.description: This function returns the current armor of the specified [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped).

getPedFightingStyle.description:
Retrieves the fighting style a player/ped is currently using.

{{New feature/item|3.0157|1.5.6|16362|Function also added client-side.}}

getPedOccupiedVehicle.description: This function gets the [vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/vehicle) that the ped is currently in or is trying to enter, if any.

getPedOccupiedVehicleSeat.description:
This function gets the seat that a specific ped is sitting in in a vehicle.

[File:vehicle seat ids.png|200px|thumb|right|Vehicle seat ids](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/File:vehicle seat ids.png|200px|thumb|right|Vehicle seat ids)

getPedStat.description: This function returns the value of the specified statistic of a specific [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped).

getPedTarget.description: This function is used to get the element a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) is currently targeting.

getPedTotalAmmo.description:
This function returns an integer that contains the total ammo in a specified [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped)'s weapon. See [weapon|Weapon Info](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/weapon|Weapon Info)

* **Note:** Clientside, this function will not return a correct value for remote player weapons that aren't in hand.

getPedWalkingStyle.description: {{New feature/item|3.0141|1.4.1|6945|Returns the walking style ID of a ped. This ID determines the set of animations that is used for walking, running etc.}}

getPedWeapon.description: This function tells you which weapon type is in a certain *[weapon|weapon slot](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/weapon|weapon slot)* of a ped.

getPedWeaponSlot.description: This function gets a ped's selected weapon slot.

getValidPedModels.description: This function returns all valid ped models. The syntax is different for server and client sides.

isPedChoking.description: This function checks if the specified [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) is choking (coughing) or not. This happens as a result of weapons that produce smoke - smoke grenades, fire extinguisher and the spray can.

isPedDead.description:
{{Server_client function}}

This function checks if the specified [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) is dead or not.

isPedDoingGangDriveby.description: This function checks if the ped is in the driveby state.

isPedDucked.description: This function checks if the specified [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) is ducked (crouched) or not.

isPedHeadless.description: With this function, you can check if a ped has a head or not.

isPedOnFire.description:
This function checks if the specified [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped) is on fire or not.

{{deprecated|isElementOnFire}}

isPedOnGround.description: This function is used to determine whether or not a ped is on the ground. This is for on-foot usage only.

isPedReloadingWeapon.description:
{{New feature/item|3.0156|1.5.5|11856|

This function is used to determine whether or not a ped is currently reloading their weapon. Useful to stop certain quick reload exploits.}}

isPedWearingJetpack.description: {{New feature/item|3.0156|1.5.5|13846|Checks whether or not a ped is currently wearing a jetpack.}}

removePedFromVehicle.description:
This function removes a ped from a vehicle immediately. This works for drivers and passengers. Note that this removes the ped from the vehicle and puts him in the exact position where the command was initiated.

*Available client side from 1.3.1* (It will only work with client side vehicles and peds)

setPedAnimation.description:
Sets the current [Animations|animation](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Animations|animation) of a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) or [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped). Not specifying the type of animation will automatically cancel the current one.

{{Warning|It is possible that an animation will be cancelled if you use setElementFrozen on the ped, but this does not happen all the time.}}

setPedAnimationProgress.description: Sets the current animation progress of a player or ped.

setPedArmor.description:
This function allows you to set the armor value of a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped).

{{New feature/item|3.0158|1.5.7|19626|Function also added client-side.}}

setPedDoingGangDriveby.description: This function sets the driveby state of a ped.

setPedFightingStyle.description:
Changes a ped's fighting style. Most styles only change the 'special attack' which is done using the Aim and Enter keys.

{{New feature/item|3.0158|1.5.7|19626|Function also added client-side.}}

setPedHeadless.description: With this function, you can set if a ped has a head or not.

setPedOnFire.description:
This function can be used to set a ped on fire or extinguish a fire on it.

{{deprecated|setElementOnFire}}

setPedWalkingStyle.description: Sets the walking style of a ped. A walking style consists of a set of animations that are used for walking, running etc.

setPedWeaponSlot.description: This function changes the selected weapon slot of a [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped).

warpPedIntoVehicle.description:
This function is used to warp or force a ped into a vehicle.  There are no animations involved when this happens.

[File:vehicle seat ids.png|200px|thumb|right|Vehicle seat ids](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/File:vehicle seat ids.png|200px|thumb|right|Vehicle seat ids)

*Available client side from 1.3.1* (It will only work with client side vehicles and peds)

{{Important Note|If you used [setElementPosition](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setElementPosition) to spawn the [ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/ped)/[player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player), this function will not work and returns *false*.}}

getPlayerTeam.description: This function gets the current [team](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/team) a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) is on.

getPlayerBlurLevel.description: This function allows you to check the current blur level of a specified [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player).

setPlayerBlurLevel.description: Sets the motion blur level on the clients screen. Accepts a value between 0 and 255.

forcePlayerMap.description: This function is used to forcefully show a player's map (F11).

getPlayerFromName.description: This function returns a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player) [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) for the player with the name passed to the function.

getPlayerMoney.description:
Returns the amount of money a player currently has.

* **Note:** The amount may vary between the server and client, you shouldn't trust the client side value to always be accurate.

getPlayerName.description: This function returns a string containing the name of the specified player.

getPlayerNametagColor.description:
<!-- Describe in plain english what this function does. Don't go into details, just give an overview -->

This function gets the current color of a player's name tag as RGB values. These are in the range 0-255.

getPlayerNametagText.description:
<!-- Describe in plain english what this function does. Don't go into details, just give an overview -->

This will allow you to retrieve the name tag a player is currently using.

getPlayerPing.description: This function returns the ping of a specified [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player). The ping is the number of milliseconds that data takes to travel from the player's client to the server or vice versa. If a player is using a VPN their ping will still be returned correctly.

getPlayerWantedLevel.description: This function gets a player's current wanted level. The wanted level is indicated by the amount of stars a player has on the GTA HUD.

givePlayerMoney.description:
This function adds money to a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player)'s current money amount.  To set absolute values, [setPlayerMoney](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setPlayerMoney) can be used.<br>

* **Note:** Using this function client side (not recommended) will not change a players money server side.

isPlayerMapForced.description: This function checks if the specified player's map (F11) has been forced on or not.

setPlayerHudComponentVisible.description: This function will show or hide a part of the player's HUD.

setPlayerMoney.description:
Sets a player's money to a certain value, regardless of current player money. It should be noted that setting negative values does not work and in fact gives the player large amounts of money.

* **Note:** Using this function client side (not recommended) will not change a players money server side.

setPlayerNametagShowing.description:
{{New feature|3|1.0|This function allows you to set whether a player's nametag visibility both clientside and serverside}}

Use this to define whether the player's name tag is visible or invisible.

setPlayerNametagText.description:
<!-- Describe in plain english what this function does. Don't go into details, just give an overview -->

This will change the text of a player's nickname in the world to something besides the nickname he chose. This will not change the player's actual nickname, it only changes the visible aspect inside the world (you will see his original nickname in the scoreboard and will refer to his original name in scripts).

takePlayerMoney.description:
This function subtracts money from a [player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/player)'s current money amount.

* **Note:** Using this function client side (not recommended) will not change a players money server side.

countPlayersInTeam.description: This function is for returning the number of players in the specified team.

getPlayersInTeam.description: This function retrieves all the players of the specified team.

setControlState.description: Sets a state of a specified player's control, as if they pressed or released it.

getControlState.description:
This function will check if a player is pressing a particular control. Controls are those that affect GTA. If you wish to get the state of another key, use [bindKey](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/bindKey) and a command function.

Note: Not all control states are sent to the server at all times, as such their state may be given incorrectly. As a rule, keys that move or affect the player or their vehicle are most likely to be accurate. For increased accuracy (and also increased bandwidth usage) use bindKey instead to bind a GTA control name to a function.

getWeaponProperty.description: This function gets a weapon property of the specified [Element/Weapon|custom weapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Element/Weapon|custom weapon) (clientside only) or specified [Weapons|player-held weapon](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Weapons|player-held weapon) (both client and server).

getPickupWeapon.description: This function retrieves the weapon ID of a weapon pickup.

getOriginalWeaponProperty.description: This function gets the original weapon property of the specified weapons specified weapon type.

getSlotFromWeapon.description: This function allows you to identify the weapon slot that a weapon belongs to.

getWeaponIDFromName.description: This function will obtain the ID of a particular weapon from its name.

getWeaponNameFromID.description:
This function allows you to retrieve the name of a weapon from an ID.

* **Note:** You can also retrieve the name of other methods of death, such as Fall and Rammed.

setWeaponAmmo.description:
<section name="setWeaponAmmo" class="server" show="true">

Sets the ammo to a certain amount for a specified weapon (if they already have it), regardless of current ammo.

setWeaponProperty.description:
<section name="Server" class="server" show="true">

This function sets the weapon property of the specified weapons specified weapon type. See lower down the page for documentation related to weapon creation.

playSoundFrontEnd.description:
This function plays a frontend sound for the specified player.

* **Note:** These sounds can be disabled with [setWorldSoundEnabled](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setWorldSoundEnabled) so if these sounds stop working you should check if you're disabling the sounds.

* **Note:** These sounds don't work when [fadeCamera](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/fadeCamera) has been used to make the screen black.

createBlip.description: This function creates a [blip](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/blip) [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element), which is displayed as an icon on the client's radar.

createBlipAttachedTo.description: This function creates a [blip](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/blip) that is attached to an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element). This blip is displayed as an icon on the client's radar and will 'follow' the element that it is attached to around.

getBlipColor.description: This function will tell you what color a blip is. This color is only applicable to the default blip icon ([Image:Blipid0s.png|12px](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Image:Blipid0s.png|12px), [Image:Blipid0u.png|12px](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Image:Blipid0u.png|12px) or [Image:Blipid0d.png|12px](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Image:Blipid0d.png|12px)). All other icons will ignore this.

getBlipIcon.description: This function returns the icon a [blip](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/blip) currently has.

getBlipOrdering.description: This function gets the Z ordering value of a blip. The Z ordering determines if a blip appears on top of or below other blips. Blips with a higher Z ordering value appear on top of blips with a lower value. The default value for all blips is 0.

getBlipSize.description: This function gets the size of a blip..

getBlipVisibleDistance.description: This function will tell you what visible distance a blip has.

setBlipColor.description: This function will let you change the color of a blip. This color is only applicable to the default blip icon ([Image:Blipid0s.png|12px](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Image:Blipid0s.png|12px), [Image:Blipid0u.png|12px](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Image:Blipid0u.png|12px) or [Image:Blipid0d.png|12px](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Image:Blipid0d.png|12px)). All other icons will ignore this.

setBlipIcon.description: This function sets the icon for an existing blip element.

setBlipOrdering.description: This function sets the Z ordering of a blip. It allows you to make a blip appear on top of or below other blips.

setBlipSize.description: This function sets the size of a blip's icon.

setBlipVisibleDistance.description: This function will set the visible distance of a blip.

fadeCamera.description:
This function will fade a player's camera to a color or back to normal over a specified time period. This will also affect the sound volume for the player (50% faded = 50% volume, full fade = no sound). For clientside scripts you can perform 2 fade ins or fade outs in a row, but for serverside scripts you must use one then the other.

* **Note:** The speed of the effect depends directly on the current gamespeed.

getCameraInterior.description: Returns the interior of the local camera (independent of the interior of the local player).

getCameraMatrix.description:
This function gets the position of the camera and the position of the point it is facing.

{{Important Note|Server-side this functions returns false or the latest value set via [setCameraMatrix](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setCameraMatrix) (called from server or client).}}

getCameraTarget.description: This function returns an [element](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/element) that corresponds to the current target of the specified player's camera (i.e. what it is following).

setCameraInterior.description: Sets the interior of the local camera. Only the interior of the camera is changed, the local player stays in the interior he was in.

setCameraMatrix.description:
This function sets the camera's position and direction. The first three arguments are the point at which the camera lies, the last three are the point the camera faces (or the point it "looks at").

* **Note:** Calling this function takes the camera's focus away from the player and sets the camera in a fixed position and rotation. The camera's focus can be brought back to the player using the [setCameraTarget](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/setCameraTarget) function.

setCameraTarget.description:
This function allows you to set a player's camera to follow other elements instead. Currently supported element type is:

*[Player](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Player)s

*[Ped](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Ped)s

*[Vehicle](https://wiki.multitheftauto.com/wiki/Vehicle)s

getBodyPartName.description: This function is used to get the name of a body part on a player.

getClothesByTypeIndex.description:
This function is used to get the texture and model of clothes by the clothes type and index.

(Scans through the list of clothes for the specific type).

getClothesTypeName.description: This function is used to get the name of a certain clothes type.

getTypeIndexFromClothes.description:
This function is used to get the clothes type and index from the texture and model.

(Scans through the list of clothes for the specific type).
